subject: art-design
source_note: Topic structure follows the CCEA GCSE Art & Design specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

topics.name: Part A: Exploratory Portfolio
topics.blurb: Must explore at least two art, craft or design disciplines

topics.name: Part B: Investigating the Creative and Cultural Industries
Disciplines: Fine art, Textiles, Ceramics, Graphic design, Photography, Moving image/animation, Digital media, 3D design
Preparatory work responding to the set stimulus (minimum 20 hours)
Final outcome under controlled conditions (10 hours)

connections.why: Investigating professional practice gives context that informs portfolio choices
Exploring at least two disciplines is the core requirement of the portfolio
Discipline skills are applied to a brief, commission or collaborative project
Exploratory skills and methods are reapplied when developing ESA preparatory work
Awareness of professional practice supports the personal response in the ESA
Preparatory development feeds directly into the controlled final outcome
The discipline skills built in Component 1 are realised in the final ESA piece
